Reading the numbers

  • $/mo is all-in: $0 due at signing, 12,000 mi/yr, 36 months. Every advertised down payment has been rolled into the monthly, so no row can buy a better rank with cash up front. Taxes and DMV excluded.
  • Advertised offers were converted as: monthly + (due at signing − first payment) × (1/36 + money factor), then a mileage step of MSRP × 1.5% ÷ 36 for 10k → 12k. Real money factors used where published, otherwise 0.00150.
  • est. means no published 36-month offer to convert — a shorter/longer term rescaled, or 1.25–1.65% of MSRP for models that haven't launched. Estimated rows show a range instead of a single number.
  • Cargo is max cu ft, all rear seats folded. Values with ~ are unverified.
  • Not this fall means the maker's own timing puts it past the fall 2026 window — kept for context, not shoppable now. Toyota's 22 Jul 2026 plant delay moved the Highlander EV, Getaway and TZ together; BMW puts the iX5 60 and new-gen X5 50e in Q1 2027; the GV90, both electric Range Rovers and the Type 01 land in 2027.
  • Three rows are unconfirmed products. No plug-in hybrid GLB has been announced — the next-gen GLB is EV and mild-hybrid only. The X3 30e xDrive is absent from BMW's current US lineup. The Defender P400e appears to be UK/Europe-only. Left on the board pending better information; treat their numbers as placeholders.

Ratings & photos

  • C/D is the Car and Driver score out of 10, scraped from their model pages. Click it to read the review.
  • ° means C/D rates the model line as a whole — no separate score for this powertrain (e.g. the Sportage page covers the plug-in).
  • — means C/D hasn't rated it: not launched, or the only page is for a different vehicle.
  • Hover any vehicle for a photo. Where the car hasn't been shown publicly, the popover says what you're actually looking at.
  • Photos from Wikimedia Commons, credited per image.

CHEAPR reality check

  • $50,000 MSRP cap. Point-of-sale only, no retroactive claims.
  • The eligible list was last updated Sep 2025 — Ioniq 9, EV9, Optiq, Trailseeker and others aren't on it yet.
  • Dealer participation is voluntary; funds are first-come.

Not here on purpose

  • Discontinued: Acura ZDX, Nissan Ariya, Tesla Model X, Audi Q8 e-tron, Mercedes EQB, Polestar 2.
  • All Stellantis PHEVs ended with MY2026 — Wrangler 4xe, Grand Cherokee 4xe, Hornet R/T, Tonale.
  • Kia Niro PHEV gone. Crosstrek Hybrid is no longer a plug-in.

Scope, on purpose

  • Used EV/PHEV purchase financing is not on this board. It ranks one thing: the monthly cost of renting a new EV for 36 months. A loan payment is not that number.
  • Used pricing is VIN-specific and turns over weekly. A hand-compiled static file can't stay honest about it — a stale lease row is a wrong number, a stale used row is a car that sold in April.
  • No incentive story to model either: the $4,000 federal used clean vehicle credit expired 30 Sep 2025, and CHEAPR is new-vehicle only.
  • For the used market use a live search, not this file — saved used-EV search ↗ (swap in your own filtered search URL).
  • If you want to own one of these, the path runs through the lease, not around it — every offer here has a contractual buyout at residual. That's priced used-EV ownership, already on the board.
